info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Wholesale Trading Market Order Execution API
info.description: The Wholesale Trading Market Order Execution API facilitates the processing and execution of market orders in the wholesale trading sector. By utilizing this API, users can submit market orders for execution, ensuring timely and efficient transaction handling. Financial institutions and trading platforms commonly integrate this API to streamline their order execution processes and improve client service. This API is essential for enabling real-time trading capabilities and managing trading activities seamlessly.

post.summary: Create a new market order execution.
